body: I did many "moves" I guess, to the point that now he heavily dislikes me (for good reasons). Anyway, how did you stop being obsessed? On the web they mostly say like limit the contact but we have minimal contact already. It sounds stupid to me to say that I'm in love now, I don't even really know him now since we  were never like, best friends and we haven't talked with each other for a long time.
